source.title: Retiring TNoodle 0.13.5
source.content:
When `TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0` was released last week, we announced that `TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5` would briefly remain an officially permitted version. Since a week has passed, `TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5` is now officially retired, leaving `TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0` as the only official scramble program.

Please see [last week's `TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0`  announcement](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/tnoodle-0-14-0) for details.

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from:
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

translation.title: TNoodle 0.13.5 停止使用
translation.content:
上周发布 `TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0` 时，我们曾说明，`TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5` 会暂时继续列为官方允许使用的版本。一周已过，`TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5` 现正式停止使用，`TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0` 成为唯一的官方打乱程序。

详情请参阅[上周的 `TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0` 发布公告](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/tnoodle-0-14-0)。

请记住，官方比赛必须使用当前有效版本的官方打乱程序。最新版始终可以从以下页面获取：
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
translation.revisionReason: 完成当前版本独立审校；正文未改。
